title: Stalk condition for explicit affine spectrum coefficients
statement: Let $f:X\to S,f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime,g:S\prime\to S,g\prime:X\prime\to X$ form a cartesian square of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Fix a pullback proof for the square of their global-section spectrum maps. Let $K\in D(\mathcal O_X),K\prime\in D(\mathcal O_{X\prime})$ and $\phi:L(g\prime)^*K\to K\prime$ [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback]. Construct $K_0,K_0\prime,\phi_0$ by [def-pc-affine-spectrum-derived-coordinates]. The stalk condition [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition] for the original data is equivalent to that for these spectrum data. No quasi-coherence, boundedness or flatness is assumed, and no direct-image comparison is asserted.

proof.text: Choose one original coordinate presentation using nonempty_coordinates. Construct a spectrum coordinate presentation with the actual termwise pulled-back complexes by lem-pc-affine-spectrum-coordinate-representatives.

At each spectrum point and degree obtain the additive arrow isomorphism from lem-pc-affine-spectrum-stalk-conjugacy. Apply Mathlib Arrow.isIso_iff_isIso_of_isIso. The ModuleCat-to-AddCommGrp forgetful functors preserve and reflect isomorphisms, giving the equivalence of invertibility in the two selected coordinate presentations.

For the forward implication, use the original StalkCondition on the selected c at isoSpec.inv z0, transport invertibility, and apply fixed-square coordinate invariance to any spectrum presentation d0. For the reverse implication, evaluate the spectrum condition at isoSpec.hom z, transport back, rewrite isoSpec.inv (isoSpec.hom z) = z using hom_inv_id, and apply original-square coordinate invariance to arbitrary c0. This proves both universal conditions, including an empty source.

theorem affineSpectrumCoordinates_stalkCondition
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X'] [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    (sq0 : IsPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop))
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') :
    SingleComplexBaseChange.StalkCondition f f' g g' sq K K' φ ↔
      SingleComplexBaseChange.StalkCondition
        (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
        (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0
        (affineSpectrumDerivedObject X K) (affineSpectrumDerivedObject X' K')
        (affineSpectrumDerivedMorphism g' K K' φ)
